description: What begins as a short stay with grandparents in Normandy becomes five years of wartime childhood for Ernest and Colette. From the declaration of war and the 1940 exodus through occupation, rationing and resistance, the children grow up inside events they only partly understand, gradually moving from observers of the adults' world to participants in the struggle around Grangeville.

s01e01.description: Ernest and Colette arrive in Normandy for what should be a brief visit with their grandparents, but war is declared, their father is mobilized and their ill mother must leave for treatment, turning the holiday into an indefinite stay.

s01e02.description: The children begin school in Grangeville during the uneasy Phoney War, meet fellow refugee Fernand, clash with local bullies and form the Robinsons around a hidden woodland refuge.

s01e03.description: As German forces break through in June 1940, the family joins the mass civilian exodus south, only to find roads, bridges and plans collapsing around them as the invasion catches up.

s01e04.description: German troops settle into Grangeville after the French defeat, requisitioning homes and forcing Ernest and Colette into a new household while the children begin learning what daily life under occupation really means.

s01e05.description: Rationing and shortages bite through the first winter of occupation when a letter arrives from the children's father in a German prisoner-of-war camp, prompting them to assemble a parcel and uncover a local black-market scheme.

s01e06.description: After a British aircraft is shot down near Grangeville, the Robinsons discover the escaped pilot hiding in their refuge and must keep him concealed while German soldiers search the area.

s01e07.description: In 1942, the compulsory yellow star and harsher German repression make the occupation more dangerous as the local resistance expands and Ernest receives news that his father has escaped captivity.

s01e08.description: By autumn 1943 the Robinsons are carrying messages, distributing tracts and keeping watch for the resistance, before being trusted with a dangerous reconnaissance mission involving German coastal batteries.

s01e09.description: With Allied preparations becoming impossible to miss, the children help with a resistance parachute operation and wait through the first days of June 1944 as news arrives that the Normandy landings have begun.

s01e10.description: As German forces discover the Robinsons' refuge and the front finally reaches Grangeville, the children and resistance members race to warn one another, sabotage communications and survive the village's last days under occupation.
